resources.string: Delete account
Deletion is permanent and cannot be undone. Your account is deleted as soon as you confirm.
Deletion permanently removes:
Kept, but no longer linked to you
Some things you shared with other people belong to their record as well, so they stay without your name or account attached:
DELETE
Permanently delete account
Deleting…
Cancel
This account has admin access, so it cannot be deleted from here. Please contact support.
Your account was not deleted and is unchanged. Please try again.
Your session has expired. Sign in again, then try again.
Your account has been deleted
Your data has been removed from our database; the photos, videos and audio you uploaded are removed from our file storage within 48 hours after that.
Go to Home
Your account and profile, including your name, profile photo, cover photo and bio.
Your chats with TappyAI and your AI memory.
Your saved places, favourites, preferences, price watches and plans.
The reviews, comments and likes you posted, including their photos and videos.
The result pages you shared publicly — their links stop working.
The photos, videos and audio you uploaded, removed from our file storage.
Groups you created, and your place in groups created by others.
Notifications you caused in other people\'s inboxes (for example \"… commented on your review\").
Your Google Calendar connection — we also revoke TappyAI\'s access at Google.
Messages you sent to other people stay in their conversation and are shown as coming from a deleted account.
Reports and moderation decisions about content or accounts are kept for safety and legal compliance, without a link to your account.
To confirm, type %1$s
You will be signed out. If you have questions, contact %1$s.
